title.narrative: IDEA 2025: Identifying Needs, Discovering Gaps, Empowering Capacity and Acting Together for an Inclusive Cultural Sector in T¿rkiye

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the action is to align more closely the status of Türkiye¿s democracy with the EU Acquis.

The specific objectives are:

- to empower cultural professionals working in municipalities and CSOs in cultural policy and management - to strengthen dialogue and collaboration in Türkiye¿s arts and culture sector through joint practices between municipalities and CSOs
